title: تواصل واضح وتسليم قابل للتنفيذ
rule:
Applies when: In user-facing delivery and session handoffs.
Use clear concise language, explain unfamiliar terms and identify the exact user decision needed. If recommending a new session, supply a copyable complete request plus a model/effort recommendation checked against the actual host; preserve candidate, branch, evidence, unresolved decisions and the scope of permission. Do not invent timings or future execution.
rationale: تسليم غامض قد يفقد المرشح والقرار وحدود الاستئناف. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
reviewCadence: Owner review before activation and after material changes
